items.summary: ## General Bug Fixes (21) * When creating a return from a **POS Invoice**, payment amounts exclude change already given, so the refund matches the original sale total. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/66206) * Updates how valuation charges are recorded on **Purchase Receipt** entries with only rejected materials: charges are excluded when _Set Valuation Rate for Rejected Materials_ is off and included in rejected stock value when it is on. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/65148) * Corrects manufacturing and stock handling in **Production Plan**, **Work Order**, and **Stock Entry**, including material reservations, transfer and finished quantities, and unit and minimum-order calculations. It also updates **Packed Item** details, **Workstation** operating costs, BOM Creator displays, and access to **Subcontracting BOM**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60742) * Adds an access check for the selected **Account** before using it to filter available **Party Type** options. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/66627) * The documentation check now reads pull request details from the workflow event instead of the GitHub API, reducing failures when API rate limits are reached. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/66853) * Creates finished-good **Serial and Batch Bundle** records, **Delivery Trip** records, and **BOM** records under the company of their relate…
